title: sloanea latifolia
intro: Sloanea latifolia, commonly known as the Red Bead Tree or Red Miling Milin, is a species of flowering plant in the family EOPTERIDACEAE. It is a medium-sized tree with a broad, rounded crown and is native to Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Sloanea latifolia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Sloanea latifolia include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
